picks.title: ArtCraft Releases Free Open-Source Adobe Alternatives – FilmCraft for Premiere Pro, EffectCraft for After Effects, Written in Rust With AI
picks.excerpt: ArtCraft releases free open-source Adobe alternatives built with AI, with FilmCraft for Premiere Pro.
picks.rationale: A new release: free, open-source editing and compositing apps (FilmCraft, EffectCraft) built with AI as Premiere Pro and After Effects alternatives. Editors can download and try them today.

picks.title: Nvidia's Editor's Day: New Windows-Based RTX Spark Computers
picks.excerpt: By Mike McCarthy  Last week, I had the opportunity to attend Nvidia's "Editor's Day" in San Francisco, which was the company's lead-up to the launch of its RTX Spark line of laptops and desktops. It was a day of presentations about AI, how the new hardware enables local AI processing and the benefit
picks.rationale: A post-production writer's report on what Nvidia's RTX Spark machines and on-device AI mean for editing workstations. It is aimed at editors, unlike the Adobe-NVIDIA tie-up that already ran in design.

picks.title: Alex Gibney on How a CGI Avatar Helped Simulate the Elon Musk Interview He Could Never Get
picks.excerpt: Alex Gibney talks about using artificial intelligence to critique it for his Elon Musk documentary, 'Musk,' on IndieWire's 'Screen Talk' podcast.
picks.rationale: The director explains a specific technique: a CGI/AI avatar used to stage a simulated interview with a subject who refused to take part. It is a concrete and ethically charged documentary method.

picks.title: 'Fall 2' reaches new heights in VFX
picks.excerpt: Koala FX breaks down its VFX for the survival-thriller sequel, including how it stress-tested Flawless's AI tools (TrueSync, first used to redub lines on 'Fall') and fed back VFX-pipeline know-how such as de-grain and flicker handling to the AI developers.
picks.rationale: A VFX vendor's breakdown of a new sequel that put Flawless's AI tools into a real pipeline. It names the specific problems (grain, flicker) VFX teams had to solve, so it is practical for compositors.

picks.title: Ava DuVernay Didn't Make a Sequel — She Made '14th'
picks.excerpt: DuVernay explains that degraded archival photos from boxes, slides and family albums couldn't reach film resolution, so she worked with Natasha Lyonne's Asteria Film Co., whose AI-powered tools restored them. (ComingSoon/World of Reel report a backlash over the film's AI-animated archival images.)
picks.rationale: A high-profile documentary premiering at NYFF used Asteria's AI tools to restore archival photos, and the AI-animated images drew a backlash. It is a concrete case of AI in archival restoration.
